class spaces.Space(name)¶

Bases: object

This class serves as the parent class for all other spaces. Each subclass overrides the activate() method to define the specific behaviour. The method gets applied when the player lands on that space.

Attributes:

name Space name

Methods:

activate Applying the effect of the space on the player
